scope: Proposition 6.3 (Boundary backgrounds) of the manuscript “Conformal universality of bulk Ising correlations under weak interactions” (preprints/Conformal-universality-of-bulk-Ising-correlations-under-weak-interactions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8a815e7845436e07), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are constants C, λ0 > 0, independent of the allowed domain and of its boundary type, with the following property. For each fixed C2 Jordan domain D there is ηD > 0 such that, for sufficiently small a, the effective background with any of the three prescribed boundary conditions has the form Ha,b j = Resa,j hj + ba,b j , ‖ ‖ ‖ba,b j ‖ ‖ ‖ rj ≤ C|λ|γj , (6.8) through all steps with arj ≤ ηD. Every carrier of ba,b j touches the physical boundary in the above sense. For free boundary conditions its functions are even; for fixed boundary conditions they need not be even.
